title: SQL & Relational Databases
description: Query real relational tables directly in your browser using SQLite WebAssembly. Master SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, JOINs, data updates, and an auto-graded analytics capstone.
outcomes: Query and filter relational tables cleanly with SELECT, WHERE, and LIKE
Sort, deduplicate, and paginate results using ORDER BY, DISTINCT, and LIMIT
Summarize metrics with COUNT, SUM, AVG, GROUP BY, and HAVING
Combine related tables safely using INNER JOIN and LEFT JOIN
Insert, update, and delete records safely with WHERE clauses
